description:
Analysis extent for Flood, Bangladesh, 2 May 2024 (FL20240502BGD): 67 features merged from 67 source layers. Layers whose names mark the area UNOSAT analysed, or parts of it with no usable imagery (analysis extent, area of interest, cloud obstruction, no-data, image footprint). The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Building Damage Assessment in Bagerhat District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh as of 4 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/building-damage-assessment-in-bagerhat-district-khulna-division-bangladesh-as-of-4-june-20)
- [Building Damage Assessment in Paikgachha Upazila, Khulna District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh as of 4 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/building-damage-assessment-in-paikgachha-upazila-khulna-district-khulna-division-banglades)
- [Building Damage Assessment in Rampal Upazila Bagerhat District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh as of 4 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/building-damage-assessment-in-rampal-upazila-bagerhat-district-khulna-division-bangladesh-)
- [Building Damage Assessment in Shyamnagar Upazila, Bagerhat District, Khulna Division, Bangladesh as of 10 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/building-damage-assessment-in-shyamnagar-upazila-bagerhat-district-khulna-division-banglad)
- [Cumulative Satellite Detected Waters over Sylhet Division, Bangladesh as of 19 & 22 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cumulative-satellite-detected-waters-over-sylhet-division-bangladesh-as-of-19-22-june-2024)
- [Flood impact analysis in Chhatak Upazila, Sunamganj District, Sylhet Division, Bangladesh as of 26 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-impact-analysis-in-chhatak-upazila-sunamganj-district-sylhet-division-bangladesh-as-)
- [Flood impact analysis in Sunamganj Sadar and Bishwambarpur Upazilas, Sunamganj District, Sylhet Division, Bangladesh as of 26 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-impact-analysis-in-sunamganj-sadar-and-bishwambarpur-upazilas-sunamganj-district-syl)
- [Flood impact analysis in Sylhet District, Sylhet Division, Bangladesh as of 26 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-impact-analysis-in-sylhet-district-sylhet-division-bangladesh-as-of-26-june-2024)
- [Satellite detected water extent over Barisal, Dhaka and Khulna Divisions, Bangladesh as of 1 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-over-barisal-dhaka-and-khulna-divisions-bangladesh-as-of-1-june-2024)
- [Satellite detected water extent over Satkhira and Khulna Districts, Khulna Divisions, Bangladesh as of 1 June 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-over-satkhira-and-khulna-districts-khulna-divisions-bangladesh-as-of-1-june-2)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 16 & 23 July 2024 in Bangladesh](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-16-23-july-2024-in-bangladesh)
- [Satellite detected water extents between 4 & 11 July 2024 in Bangladesh](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-between-4-11-july-2024-in-bangladesh)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Stadium; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 42 = Military Facility; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 46 = Airport Facility; 47 = Church; 48 = Dam; 49 = Port. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `SensorID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: GlobalID
table:columns.description: ArcGIS global identifier of the feature.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Leng
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
